Amos Slade and his hunting dogs

Beef topside sliced thin, marinated overnight in soy, Worcestershire, pepper and garlic, dried at 75C for 4 hours until chewy. Freeze 800g beef topside for 1 hour so it slices easily, then cut across the grain into 3mm strips, trimming off fat. Mix 80ml soy, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 2 crushed garlic cloves and 1 tbsp cracked black pepper. Marinate the beef overnight in the fridge. Pat dry, lay on wire racks over trays and dry at 75C for 4 hours with the oven door slightly open until chewy. Cool before serving.

Country beef pot roast and gravy
the farm on the edge of the forest

Beef chuck braised at 160C for 3 hours with onion, carrots and potatoes in stock, gravy from the pot. Season a 1.5kg beef chuck roast and brown all over in a heavy pot. Add 2 quartered onions, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp tomato paste, a few thyme sprigs and 500ml beef stock. Cover and braise at 160C for 2 hours. Add 4 carrots and 800g potatoes in big chunks and braise 1 hour more. Lift out the meat and veg, simmer the liquid with 1 tbsp cornflour mixed with water until it thickens to gravy, and pour over the sliced beef.
W: the berry bushes on the farm
Blackberries tossed with sugar under a buttery cobbler topping, baked at 180C for 40 minutes, with vanilla ice cream.
K: Fresh strawberries blended with cold full cream milk, vanilla ice cream and honey until pink and frothy, poured into jars. Hull 250g strawberries and blend with 500ml cold full cream milk, 4 scoops vanilla ice cream, 1 tbsp honey and a drop of vanilla until smooth and frothy. Pour into 4 glass jars and top each with a halved strawberry. Serve straight away.

s.how: Rub 100g cold butter into 450g self-raising flour with a pinch of salt. Stir in 300ml buttermilk until just combined. Pat out, cut into rounds and bake at 220C for 14 minutes. Serve warm with butter and honey.

s.note: Tod and Copper playing by the creek
s.how: Toss 125g blackberries and 125g blueberries with a spoon of honey and torn mint. Spoon over whipped cream in small cups. A sweet snack for two friends playing by the creek.

m.how: Simmer 800g chicken thighs with sliced carrot, celery and onion in 1.5L water for 40 minutes. Rub butter into 200g self-raising flour, add chopped parsley and water to a soft dough. Drop spoonfuls on top, cover and cook 20 minutes.

w.note: the berry bushes on the farm
w.how: Toss 500g blackberries with 80g sugar and spread in a dish. Rub 80g butter into 250g self-raising flour, add 150ml milk and drop rough spoonfuls over the fruit. Bake at 180C for 40 minutes. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

d.how: Hull 250g strawberries and blend with 500ml cold full cream milk, 4 scoops vanilla ice cream, 1 tbsp honey and a drop of vanilla until smooth and frothy. Pour into 4 glass jars and top each with a halved strawberry. Serve straight away.
